---
title: "Weekly Zoonoses Surveillance Report"
subtitle: "Campylobacter, Salmonella, EHEC and Listeria — synthetic demo data"
params:
  week: "2026-09-07"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    theme: cosmo
    toc: false
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(arrow)
library(DBI)
library(surveillance)

# Report week: always the Monday of the week given in params$week.
report_week <- as.Date(params$week)
report_week <- report_week - (as.POSIXlt(report_week)$wday + 6) %% 7
week_end    <- report_week + 6
prev_week   <- report_week - 7

data_dir <- "data"

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
```

```{r}
#| label: connect
# Case line list lives in PostgreSQL. Connection values come from
# environment variables (for example in .Renviron or Connect "Vars").
con <- dbConnect(
  RPostgres::Postgres(),
  host     = Sys.getenv("PG_HOST"),
  port     = as.integer(Sys.getenv("PG_PORT", "5432")),
  dbname   = Sys.getenv("PG_DB"),
  user     = Sys.getenv("PG_USER"),
  password = Sys.getenv("PG_PASSWORD")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
# dplyr code below is translated to SQL and runs in the database.
cases <- tbl(con, "cases") |>
  filter(sample_date <= !!week_end) |>
  select(case_id, pathogen, sample_date, county_name,
         age_group, travel_associated, hospitalised) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(sample_date = as.Date(sample_date))

dbDisconnect(con)

# Lab and genomic data: Parquet files (later: the S3 data lake).
weekly   <- read_parquet(file.path(data_dir, "weekly_counts.parquet")) |>
  mutate(week_start = as.Date(week_start)) |>
  filter(week_start <= report_week)
isolates <- read_parquet(file.path(data_dir, "isolates.parquet"))
ast      <- read_parquet(file.path(data_dir, "ast_results.parquet"))
```

**Report week:** `r format(report_week, "%G-W%V")` (`r format(report_week, "%d %b %Y")` – `r format(week_end, "%d %b %Y")`)

## Cases this week

```{r}
#| label: headline
this_wk <- cases |> filter(sample_date >= report_week, sample_date <= week_end)
last_wk <- cases |> filter(sample_date >= prev_week, sample_date < report_week)

headline <- tibble(pathogen = sort(unique(cases$pathogen))) |>
  left_join(count(this_wk, pathogen, name = "this_week"), by = "pathogen") |>
  left_join(count(last_wk, pathogen, name = "last_week"), by = "pathogen") |>
  left_join(this_wk |> filter(hospitalised) |> count(pathogen, name = "hospitalised"),
            by = "pathogen") |>
  mutate(across(c(this_week, last_week, hospitalised), \(x) coalesce(x, 0L)),
         change = this_week - last_week,
         change = if_else(change > 0, paste0("+", change), as.character(change)))

knitr::kable(
  headline |> select(pathogen, this_week, last_week, change, hospitalised),
  col.names = c("Pathogen", "This week", "Last week", "Change", "Hospitalised"),
  align = "lrrrr"
)
```

## Weekly trend (last two years)

```{r}
#| label: trend
#| fig-height: 5
trend <- weekly |>
  filter(week_start > report_week - 7 * 104) |>
  group_by(week_start, pathogen) |>
  summarise(cases = sum(cases), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(trend, aes(week_start, cases)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = report_week - 7 * 11, xmax = week_end,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#F4D35E", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(colour = "#1F5A96") +
  facet_wrap(~pathogen, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cases per week",
       caption = "Shaded: last 12 weeks")
```

## Outbreak alerts: Salmonella by county

Method: `surveillance::farringtonFlexible()`, checked for the last 8 weeks, compared with the same period in earlier years.

```{r}
#| label: farrington
sal <- weekly |>
  filter(pathogen == "Salmonella") |>
  select(week_start, county_name, cases) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = county_name, values_from = cases, values_fill = 0) |>
  arrange(week_start)

obs <- as.matrix(sal[, -1])
n   <- nrow(obs)
w   <- 3
b   <- min(3, floor((n - 8 - w) / 52))

sal_sts <- sts(observed = obs, epoch = as.numeric(sal$week_start),
               epochAsDate = TRUE, frequency = 52)

res <- farringtonFlexible(sal_sts, control = list(
  range = (n - 7):n, b = b, w = w, alpha = 0.01,
  noPeriods = 10, populationOffset = FALSE
))

alerts <- tibble(
  week_start = rep(as.Date(epoch(res)), times = ncol(res)),
  county     = rep(colnames(observed(res)), each = nrow(res)),
  observed   = as.vector(observed(res)),
  threshold  = round(as.vector(upperbound(res)), 1),
  alarm      = as.vector(alarms(res))
)

alarm_tbl <- alerts |>
  filter(alarm) |>
  arrange(desc(week_start), desc(observed)) |>
  mutate(week = format(week_start, "%G-W%V")) |>
  select(week, county, observed, threshold)
```

```{r}
#| label: alert-table
if (nrow(alarm_tbl) == 0) {
  cat("No alerts in the last 8 weeks.")
} else {
  knitr::kable(alarm_tbl, col.names = c("Week", "County", "Cases", "Alert threshold"),
               align = "llrr")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: alert-plot
#| fig-height: 4
alert_counties <- unique(alarm_tbl$county)
if (length(alert_counties) > 0) {
  alerts |>
    filter(county %in% alert_counties) |>
    ggplot(aes(week_start)) +
    geom_col(aes(y = observed, fill = alarm)) +
    geom_step(aes(y = threshold), direction = "mid", colour = "grey30") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#9BB7D4", `TRUE` = "#C0392B"),
                      labels = c("Normal", "Alert"), name = NULL) +
    facet_wrap(~county) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Cases per week", caption = "Line: alert threshold")
}
```

## Genomic clusters (last 6 weeks)

Clusters with 5 or more isolates of the same pathogen, sampled in the last 6 weeks.

```{r}
#| label: clusters
recent_iso <- isolates |>
  filter(!is.na(cgmlst_cluster)) |>
  inner_join(cases |> select(case_id, sample_date, county_name), by = "case_id") |>
  filter(sample_date > week_end - 42)

clusters <- recent_iso |>
  group_by(cgmlst_cluster, pathogen) |>
  filter(n() >= 5) |>
  summarise(
    isolates    = n(),
    subtype     = paste(unique(subtype), collapse = ", "),
    counties    = paste(sort(unique(county_name)), collapse = ", "),
    first       = min(sample_date),
    last        = max(sample_date),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (nrow(clusters) == 0) {
  cat("No clusters with 5 or more isolates in the last 6 weeks.")
} else {
  profile <- ast |>
    inner_join(recent_iso |> select(isolate_id, cgmlst_cluster), by = "isolate_id") |>
    semi_join(clusters, by = "cgmlst_cluster") |>
    group_by(cgmlst_cluster, antibiotic) |>
    summarise(pct_r = mean(result == "R"), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(pct_r >= 0.5) |>
    group_by(cgmlst_cluster) |>
    summarise(resistant_to = paste(antibiotic, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop")

  clusters |>
    left_join(profile, by = "cgmlst_cluster") |>
    mutate(resistant_to = coalesce(resistant_to, "none")) |>
    select(cgmlst_cluster, pathogen, subtype, isolates, counties, first, last, resistant_to) |>
    knitr::kable(col.names = c("Cluster", "Pathogen", "Subtype", "Isolates",
                               "Counties", "First sample", "Last sample", "Resistant to"))
}
```

## Ciprofloxacin resistance in Campylobacter

```{r}
#| label: cipro
#| fig-height: 3.5
cipro <- ast |>
  filter(antibiotic == "ciprofloxacin") |>
  inner_join(isolates |> filter(pathogen == "Campylobacter") |> select(isolate_id, case_id),
             by = "isolate_id") |>
  inner_join(cases |> select(case_id, sample_date, travel_associated), by = "case_id") |>
  mutate(year = format(sample_date, "%Y"),
         origin = if_else(travel_associated, "Travel-associated", "Domestic")) |>
  group_by(year, origin) |>
  summarise(pct_r = 100 * mean(result == "R"), tested = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(cipro, aes(year, pct_r, colour = origin, group = origin)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Domestic = "#1F5A96", `Travel-associated` = "#E07A1F")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% resistant", colour = NULL)
```

---

*Synthetic data made for a Posit demo. It contains no real people, cases or lab results.*
